jobs.description:
1 Senior Category Manager with French - Fix- Term Contract 1.5 years (All Genders) 1) Commercial execution & coordination

 * Support the definition and execution of the annual category and promo plan
 * Own the operational implementation of promotions in CPM and related systems
 * Coordinate with CRM, Shop Operations, Graphics and central teams to ensure high-quality campaign execution
 * Ensure banners, landing pages, category pages and product selections are correctly implemented
 * Proactively follow up on open actions, tickets, and execution topics across teams

2) Pricing & competitiveness (operational focus)

 * Prepare and execute local price change requests within the global pricing framework
 * Monitor competitor actions, pricing and price indices on key brands and products
 * Drive price analyses, impact tracking and decision material

3) Promotions & performance tracking

 * Maintain the promo plan overview and track budget usage vs plan
 * Monitor campaign and promo performance (NS, margin, ROI, mechanics performance, etc.)
 * Prepare post-promo analyses and performance summaries
 * Support short-term tactical promo actions when needed (e.g. stock situations, competitive moves)

4) Shop & shelf management

 * Own the operational quality of category presentation in the shop (PLPs, search, recommendations, banners)
 * Coordinate with Product and Shop Operations on sorting rules, filters, upsell and cross-sell logic
 * Ensure strong visibility and correct execution of Own Brands
 * Regularly QA category pages and proactively fix content, navigation or presentation issues

5) Business performance & reporting

 * Monitor and maintain regular performance tracking on: Net Sales, Margin, Promo Spend , Key brands and categories, Availability and stock issues, Customer and product KPIs
 * Analyze deviations vs plan and prepare clear summaries and action proposals

Success in this role means

 * Category plans are executed on time and with high quality
 * Promos, pricing and shop setups are reliable and well controlled
 * Performance issues are detected early and clearly reported

Qualifications

 * Relevant experience in e-commerce, retail, FMCG or a similar commercial environment
 * Strong analytical skills and high confidence working with data, Excel and reporting tools
 * Very structured and reliable way of working; strong attention to detail
 * Hands-on, proactive, and comfortable managing many parallel operational topics
 * Good communication skills and confidence working with multiple stakeholders
 * Strong ownership mindset for execution quality and follow-up
 * Fluent in English; French is a strong plus.

Additional Information

Headquartered in Munich, with offices across Madrid, Krakow, Wroclaw, London and Vienna, we collaborate because we genuinely love working together - so you'll be at the heart of an incredible, multinational team. We trust each other to get the job done, which means you'll benefit from hybrid working, spending 60% of your time in the office and 40% at home. There's an option to work for 20 days abroad in approved countries too.

Add to that development opportunities that help you to shape your own career path, excellent training and support, wellbeing offers, subsidised transport or bike leasing, plus 20% discount across all our products, and you'll begin to get a sense of what sets us apart. Find out more about the specific benefits at your local office in our https://careers.zooplus.com/blogs/zooplus-blog/search.

At zooplus, we believe in equal opportunity and support everyone to fulfil their potential. We recognise the power of listening and learning from each other and embrace diversity and inclusion of all.
